get.summary: Export the project's guidance as format v5 (members)
get.description: Contains only the project's overrides with their base skill versions. With `includeDefaults=true` the effective text of every entry is included (defaults carry the current skill version).

post.summary: Replace the project's guidance overrides from an export (owners)
post.description: Accepts format `backlog-guidance` version 5, or a version 4 configuration export of the single-user app (principles, type instructions and templates; the free-text `instructions` field is ignored). Everything is validated first; all overrides are then replaced in one transaction. Entries identical to the current skill default are not stored, and entries missing from the document fall back to the default.

get.summary: List the sources of a project

post.summary: Add a source (file upload, URL or pasted text)
post.description: Multipart (`file`, optional `name`, `mode`) or JSON (`{url, pastedText?, name?, mode?}` or `{text, name, mode?}`). Files: PDF (page and size limits from settings) or UTF-8 text, checked by content. A URL is fetched by the server (https, public addresses only); if that fails the response is 422 `url-fetch-failed` and the client can resend the URL with `pastedText`.

post.summary: Get a short-lived ticket for opening the event stream without an Authorization header

get.description:
Server-sent events: the project stream, stream tickets, presence and the internal stream for agent-service.

Wire format (``text/event-stream``), one block per event::

    id: 42
    event: item.updated
    data: {"id":42,"type":"item.updated","projectId":"…","actor":"alice@example.test","actorName":"Alice",
           "data":{…},"at":"…"}

* ``id`` is the ``project_events`` id (resume with ``Last-Event-ID`` or ``?lastEventId=``). Transient events
  (``presence``, ``reset``, ``closed``) have no ``id`` unless noted.
* A comment line (``: keepalive``) is sent every ``BACKLOG_EVENTS_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS``; the response is never buffered.
* ``reset``: the requested id is outside the resume window; the client must refetch everything. Its ``id`` is the
  current end of the log so a later reconnect resumes from there.
* ``closed`` (``data.data.reason``): the server ends the stream. ``member-removed``, ``project-deleted`` and
  ``not-a-member`` are final (do not reconnect); ``max-lifetime`` is routine (reconnect with ``Last-Event-ID``).

Authentication of the project stream: ``Authorization: Bearer <access token>`` (fetch-based clients) or ``?ticket=``,
a 60 s HMAC ticket from ``POST /projects/{id}/events/ticket`` for browsers' ``EventSource``, which cannot set headers.
Tickets are bound to one user and one project and are only accepted here. A ticket is only checked when the stream is
opened: after a connection drop, request a new ticket and pass ``lastEventId`` explicitly.
